title: Śrī Śrī Nitāi-Chaitanya Ārati
author: by Śrīla Bhakti Sundar Govinda Dev-Goswāmī Mahārāj
for the āratis in our Jagannāth Purī Temple

translation: All glories to Śrīla Guru Mahārāj, Śrīla Bhakti Rakṣak Śrīdhar Dev-Goswāmī Mahārāj, who is like an ocean of mercy.
By his mercy, Śrī Śrī Nitāi-Chaitanyadev have manifested in Puri Dhām bestowing auspiciousness upon the whole world and revealing Their effulgent devotional service.
Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu’s form is dancing ecstatically, intoxicated with divine love for Śrī Gaura, whose manifestation is Rasarāj Śrī Kṛṣṇa taking the heart and halo of Mahābhāva, Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī.
Both Lords are standing fully effulgent, glowing just like freshly cut gold, as garlands of various beautiful forest flowers play on their necks.

Millions and millions of Cupids fall unconscious before the divine feet of Their Lordships, seeing Their beauty as Their divine forms playfully sway to and fro. They are dancing, touching the hearts of everyone and freely bestowing mercy upon the conditioned souls.
Brilliant like millions of moons, They stand effulgent upon Their jewelled throne. The fortunate souls, their devotional eyes full of love and affection, can see Their divine forms.

In the temple during the ārati, the mṛdaṅgas resound sweetly as conchshells are blown and the ghee lamp is offered. The different parts of the Vedas within bhakti yoga have taken form in each light, and through this form they are worshipping Their Lordships in the ārati.
The enchanting beauty of the Two (Śrī Śrī Nitāi-Chaitanya) captivates all the worlds. The residents of hidden Vṛndāvan behold it without end.
They are the treasure of Śrī Svarūp Dāmodar, Rāmānanda Rāya, Rūpa Goswāmī, Sanātan Goswāmī, Raghunāth Dās Goswāmī, Haridās Ṭhākur and Gadādhar Paṇḍit.
Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭāchārya, Gopīnāth Āchārya and the followers in the sampradāya of Jīva Goswāmī behold the splendour of the ārati – a vision rarely attained.
Śrī Nityānanda and Śrī Gaura Mahāprabhu have manifested eternally in Nabadwīp Dhām, Nadia. But now Their divine forms have manifested in Puri Dhām, mercifully given by our fortune-maker, Śrī Gurudev.

text: śrī guru-prasāde dekhe ei adhama dāsa
translation: Inconceivably Śrī Śrī Nitāi-Chaitanya have manifested, and through the mercy of Śrī Gurudev this fallen soul sees Their ārati and joins within the saṅkīrtan.
